title: Functions and Graphing
description: Explore functions, coordinate planes, and linear graphs.

pedagogy.title: Quadrants
pedagogy.content: Counter-clockwise from the top right: All, Silver, Teacups, Dance. All positive, then negative x, then both negative, then negative y.

content.content: A coordinate plane has a horizontal x-axis and a vertical y-axis. An ordered pair $(x, y)$ tells you how far to move right and up.

exercises.question: Plot the point $(2, 3)$ on the coordinate plane.
hints: Move 2 units right and 3 units up.
exercises.solution: A point at (2, 3) in the first quadrant.

exercises.question: In which quadrant is the point $(-4, 5)$?
hints: The x-coordinate is negative and the y-coordinate is positive.
exercises.solution: Negative x and positive y is quadrant II.

pedagogy.title: Slope-intercept form
pedagogy.content: $y = mx + b$ gives the slope $m$ and the y-intercept $b$.

content.content: A linear function has a constant rate of change called slope. Its graph is a straight line.

exercises.question: Graph the line $y = x + 2$.
hints: The slope is 1, so rise 1 and run 1.

lessons.title: Slope of a Line
objectives: Interpret slope as rate of change

pedagogy.title: Rise over run
pedagogy.content: Slope is rise over run: $m = \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$.

content.content: Slope measures steepness. It is the ratio of vertical change to horizontal change between two points.

exercises.question: Graph a line with slope $-2$ passing through $(0, 1)$.
hints: Move right 1 and down 2 to find another point.
